item.title: Proceedings of IKCS North America 2025 - Abstracts
item.description: We are pleased to present the abstracts accepted for the 2025 IKCS North America meeting! The research detailed here will be presented on stage and exhibited during our meeting, representing the best of what our scientific community has to offer.
